items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: That one time, Jelly Rolls played there, and then Albert Cal played there.

ctx.x: Who was the piano player at the Lula White? Who played there? Well, there were several different fellas.
That one time, Jelly Rolls played there, and then Albert Cal played there.
Did you ever hear of a guy whose name is Manuel Mineta? Manuel Mineta, sure. Do you know him?
